results.full_answer:
EXTERNAL VERIFIED DISCOVERY (NVIDIA Corporation - Market Capitalization Grounding):

• Provider & Date-Stamped Valuation Analysis:
  Market capitalization figures vary between financial tracking providers and must be evaluated with explicit timestamps rather than treated as timeless values:
  1. TipRanks: On November 20, 2026, TipRanks displayed NVIDIA's market capitalization as $3.64 Trillion USD ($3,640,000,000,000 USD).
  2. Stock Analysis: Stock Analysis displayed $3.52 Trillion USD ($3,520,000,000,000 USD) based on November 19, 2026 market close data.

• Provider Discrepancy Reconciliation:
  The difference of approximately $120 Billion USD between providers reflects intraday trading swings on NASDAQ (NVDA), timing differences in post-market adjustments, and differing methodology for basic versus diluted weighted-average shares outstanding.

• Historical Context:
  NVIDIA was founded on April 5, 1993, by Jensen Huang, Chris Malachowsky, and Curtis Priem in Sunnyvale, California.

• Memoir Separation Notice:
  NVIDIA Corporation was established two years after the 1991 conclusion of the founder's autobiography. The uploaded memoir contains zero references to NVIDIA.

results.description: External research requiring official Epic Games documentation & laptop specifications.
results.expected_summary: External research required. Epic UE5.9 recommended development config (Windows 11, Quad-core 2.5 GHz+, 32GB RAM, 8GB+ GPU memory, DirectX 12) vs minimum OS (64-bit Windows 10 22H2).

According to official Epic Games Documentation (Unreal Engine 5.0 through UE 5.9 specifications) for run...
results.full_answer:
EXTERNAL VERIFIED DISCOVERY (Epic Games - Unreal Engine 5 Specifications):

According to official Epic Games Documentation (Unreal Engine 5.0 through UE 5.9 specifications) for running Unreal Engine 5 on a Windows laptop:

• Recommended Windows Development Configuration:
  - Operating System: Windows 11
  - Processor (CPU): Quad-core Intel or AMD processor, 2.5 GHz or faster
  - Memory (RAM): 32 GB
  - Graphics Memory (VRAM): 8 GB or more dedicated video memory
  - Graphics Card (GPU): DirectX 12 compatible graphics card with latest vendor drivers

• Minimum Software Requirement (Do Not Confuse with Recommended Development Config):
  - Operating System: 64-bit Windows 10 version 22H2
  - Storage: SSD with minimum 100 GB free space for engine and intermediate build cache

• Official Documentation Source:
  Epic Games Developer Community: Hardware and Software Specifications for Unreal Engine
  https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/unreal-engine/hardware-and-software-specifications-for-unreal-engine

• Memoir Separation Notice:
  Unreal Engine 5 was developed and published decades after the 1984–1991 events chronicled in the microprocessor founder memoir. The memoir makes zero reference to 3D game engines.
